Cashier Job at the Choice Sanitary Wares Limited




        
    

        
        The Choice Sanitary Wares Nigeria is a Limited liability company duly registered under the relevant laws of the federal republic of Nigeria. We have over the years, consistently delivered high quality, affordable & reliable products & services to all our customers. This we accomplish through various delivery channels. Our vast knowledge & many years of experience have put us in the lead of the building & plumbing materials business in Nigeria & beyond. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Cashier

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Primary Purpose is to handle all cash and sales transactions accurately, maintain daily sales records, and ensure proper documentation of payments received.


Key Duties & Responsibilities
Sales & Payment Collection:


	Receive payments for goods sold.
	Cash, POS, Bank Transfer.
	Issue official receipts for every payment received.
	Confirm bank transfers before releasing goods.
	Ensure correct pricing is used.


Daily Cash Management:


	Open and close cash float at start and end of each day.
	Balance cash drawer and POS at the end of the day.
	Prepare daily cash sales report and bank lodgment.
	Hand over cash and report to Account Officer / Management daily.


Documentation & Record Keeping:


	Record all sales in the sales register / system.
	File copies of receipts, invoices, and bank tellers daily.
	Reconcile sales with inventory releases from Stock Officer.
	Flag any price discrepancies.


Customer Service:


	Attend to customers professionally and politely.
	Handle complaints about billing and refer to supervisor if needed.
	Maintain a neat and organized cashier area


Compliance:


	No release of goods without payment confirmation.
	No discounts or price changes without approval.
	Maintain confidentiality of company financial information.


Salary
N110,000 - N180,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Customer Service Officer",
  "description": "Jobs Expert, a recruitment services firm, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Officer

Job Location: Omole phase 2, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Customer Service
Reports To: Customer Service Manager/Operations Manager

Job Description


	The Customer Service Officer is responsible for handling customer enquiries, resolving complaints, providing accurate information, and ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the customer journey.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer enquiries through phone calls, emails, WhatsApp, and other channels.
	Attend to customer complaints and provide timely resolutions.
	Provide accurate information about the company&rsquo;s products and services.
	Follow up with customers on requests, complaints, orders, and service issues.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and complaints.
	Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or supervisor.
	Monitor customer satisfaction and identify recurring issues.
	Coordinate with sales, operations, and other departments to resolve customer concerns.
	Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
	Prepare customer service reports and provide feedback to management.
	Follow company customer service policies and procedures.


Requirements


	HND / Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
	1&ndash;3 years of experience in customer service, front desk, sales, or a related role.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and customer service tools.
	Experience handling customer complaints and enquiries is an advantage.
	Ability to communicate professionally with different types of customers.


Key Skills:


	Excellent verbal and written communication
	Active listening

Internal Auditor Job at Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc




        
    

        
        Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc is the premier, largest and most profitable, non-aligned Primary Mortgage Bank in Nigeria. Abbey is one of the seven national Primary Mortgage Banks (PMB) licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria and Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria (FMBN). The recent recapitalization exercise saw the downsize from 105 mortgage banks to only 34 now surviving. We not only emerged successfully capitalized but one of the few that also met our National obligation as well as amongst the public liability companies. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Internal Auditor

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Lead and execute audits Of branches and Head Office functions in line with the Bank's risk-based audit plan.
	Identify control gaps, regulatory breaches, fraud risks, and potential loss exposures, and recommend corrective actions.
	Monitor and drive the closure Of audit findings, regulatory exceptions, and outstanding control Issues.
	Assess compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
	Conduct special investigations, spot checks, and surprise cash audits as required.
	Prepare and maintain high-quality audit reports proper, audit documentation and working papers in line with regulatory and professional standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum Of 6-10 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, within thecommercial banking industry.
	Professional certification such as ACA ACCA, CIA, CISA, Or equivalent Will be an added advantage.
	Sound knowledge Of banking operations, risk management, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
	Strong analytical, investigative, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Stock Officer",
  "description": "The Choice Sanitary Wares Nigeria is a Limited liability company duly registered under the relevant laws of the federal republic of Nigeria. We have over the years, consistently delivered high quality, affordable &amp; reliable products &amp; services to all our customers. This we accomplish through various delivery channels. Our vast knowledge &amp; many years of experience have put us in the lead of the building &amp; plumbing materials business in Nigeria &amp; beyond.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Stock Officer

Job Location: Lagos&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Receiving of Goods:


	Receive goods from suppliers, warehouses, and other branches.
	Count and inspect all goods received before accepting them.
	Verify goods against invoices, waybills, purchase orders, and transfer documents.
	Report shortages, excesses, damages, or wrong items immediately.
	Ensure received goods are properly documented and entered into the appropriate stock records.


Stock Arrangement and Storage:


	Arrange stock properly according to product type, size, colour, model, and specification.
	Ensure the warehouse is clean, organized, and safe.
	Ensure fast-moving and fragile items are stored appropriately.
	Maintain proper identification and labelling of stock.
	Prevent unnecessary damage, breakage, or deterioration of goods.


Stock Issuing and Movement:


	Release goods only upon receipt of properly authorized documentation.
	Verify items and quantities before goods leave the warehouse.
	Record all stock issued, transferred, returned, or received.
	Ensure inter-branch transfers are properly documented and acknowledged.
	Work closely with the Sales, Logistics, Inventory, and Accounts teams to ensure accurate stock movement.
	Stock Counting and Reconciliation
	Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly stock counts as directed by management.
	Compare physical stock with system and stock-book records.
	Investigate and report discrepancies immediately.
	Participate in periodic stocktaking and audit exercises.
	Maintain accurate stock balances for all products.


Stock Control:


	Monitor stock levels and notify management of low-stock or excess-stock situations.
	Identify slow-moving, damaged, obsolete, or dead stock.
	Ensure no unauthorized person removes or handles company stock.
	Monitor stock movement to minimize losses, theft, and wastage.
	Maintain proper control over keys and access to the stock area where applicable.


Documentation and Record Keeping:


	Maintain accurate stock books, bin cards, waybills, goods received notes, transfer documents, and other stock records.
	Ensure all stock transactions are recorded promptly.
	File stock documents properly for easy retrieval and audit purposes.
	Ensure stock records are not altered or manipulated without proper authorization.


Coordination with Other Departments:


	Work closely with Sales to confirm availability of products.
	Coordinate with Logistics during loading, delivery, and inter-branch transfers.
	Liaise with Procurement regarding incoming stock and expected deliveries.
	Work with Accounts on stock-related documentation and reconciliation.
	Report stock issues to the Branch Manager or designated supervisor.


Loading and Offloading:


	Supervise the counting and checking of goods during loading and offloading.
	Ensure the driver or relevant representative is present during loading and delivery handover.
	Confirm that the quantity loaded corresponds with the approved documentation.
	Report any discrepancy or damage immediately.


Reporting:


	Submit daily or periodic stock reports as required.
	Report stock shortages, excesses, damages, and discrepancies.
	Provide updates on stock availability and warehouse conditions.
	Escalate suspected theft, fraud, unauthorized stock movement, or negligence immediately.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Accuracy of physical stock against records.
	Reduction in stock shortages and unexplained variances.
	Proper documentation of all stock movements.
	Accuracy of goods received and issued.
	Proper warehouse organization and cleanliness.
	Reduction in damaged and missing goods.
	Timely completion of stock counts and reconciliation.
	Compliance with stock control procedures.
	Timely submission of stock reports.
	Zero unauthorized release or movement of company goods.


Required Qualifications and Skills


	Minimum of OND / HND / Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
	Previous experience in stock control, warehouse operations, inventory, or building materials/sanitary ware is an advantage.
	Good numerical and record-keeping skills.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to identify stock discrepancies.
	Basic computer and inventory software skills.
	Good communication and organizational skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.


Personal Attributes:


	The Stock Officer must be honest, accountable, organized, observant, physically fit, detail-oriented, and disciplined. The officer must demonstrate a high level of integrity because the position involves direct responsibility for company stock and stock records.


Authority and Accountability:


	The Stock Officer is accountable for the accuracy, safety, and proper documentation of stock under their custody. No goods should be released, transferred, or removed without proper authorization and documentation.
	Any negligence, unauthorized release of goods, falsification of stock records, concealment of discrepancies, or failure to report stock losses may result in disciplinary action in accordance with company policy.


Salary
N135,000 - N175,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualiied candidates should send their CV to: stanella81@gmail.com using the&nbsp;&nbsp;Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Stock Officer Job at the Choice Sanitary Wares Limited




        
    

        
        The Choice Sanitary Wares Nigeria is a Limited liability company duly registered under the relevant laws of the federal republic of Nigeria. We have over the years, consistently delivered high quality, affordable & reliable products & services to all our customers. This we accomplish through various delivery channels. Our vast knowledge & many years of experience have put us in the lead of the building & plumbing materials business in Nigeria & beyond. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Stock Officer

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Receiving of Goods:
     

            
    




	Receive goods from suppliers, warehouses, and other branches.
	Count and inspect all goods received before accepting them.
	Verify goods against invoices, waybills, purchase orders, and transfer documents.
	Report shortages, excesses, damages, or wrong items immediately.
	Ensure received goods are properly documented and entered into the appropriate stock records.


Stock Arrangement and Storage:


	Arrange stock properly according to product type, size, colour, model, and specification.
	Ensure the warehouse is clean, organized, and safe.
	Ensure fast-moving and fragile items are stored appropriately.
	Maintain proper identification and labelling of stock.
	Prevent unnecessary damage, breakage, or deterioration of goods.


Stock Issuing and Movement:


	Release goods only upon receipt of properly authorized documentation.
	Verify items and quantities before goods leave the warehouse.
	Record all stock issued, transferred, returned, or received.
	Ensure inter-branch transfers are properly documented and acknowledged.
	Work closely with the Sales, Logistics, Inventory, and Accounts teams to ensure accurate stock movement.
	Stock Counting and Reconciliation
	Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly stock counts as directed by management.
	Compare physical stock with system and stock-book records.
	Investigate and report discrepancies immediately.
	Participate in periodic stocktaking and audit exercises.
	Maintain accurate stock balances for all products.


Stock Control:


	Monitor stock levels and notify management of low-stock or excess-stock situations.
	Identify slow-moving, damaged, obsolete, or dead stock.
	Ensure no unauthorized person removes or handles company stock.
	Monitor stock movement to minimize losses, theft, and wastage.
	Maintain proper control over keys and access to the stock area where applicable.


Documentation and Record Keeping:


	Maintain accurate stock books, bin cards, waybills, goods received notes, transfer documents, and other stock records.
	Ensure all stock transactions are recorded promptly.
	File stock documents properly for easy retrieval and audit purposes.
	Ensure stock records are not altered or manipulated without proper authorization.


Coordination with Other Departments:


	Work closely with Sales to confirm availability of products.
	Coordinate with Logistics during loading, delivery, and inter-branch transfers.
	Liaise with Procurement regarding incoming stock and expected deliveries.
	Work with Accounts on stock-related documentation and reconciliation.
	Report stock issues to the Branch Manager or designated supervisor.


Loading and Offloading:


	Supervise the counting and checking of goods during loading and offloading.
	Ensure the driver or relevant representative is present during loading and delivery handover.
	Confirm that the quantity loaded corresponds with the approved documentation.
	Report any discrepancy or damage immediately.


Reporting:


	Submit daily or periodic stock reports as required.
	Report stock shortages, excesses, damages, and discrepancies.
	Provide updates on stock availability and warehouse conditions.
	Escalate suspected theft, fraud, unauthorized stock movement, or negligence immediately.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Accuracy of physical stock against records.
	Reduction in stock shortages and unexplained variances.
	Proper documentation of all stock movements.
	Accuracy of goods received and issued.
	Proper warehouse organization and cleanliness.
	Reduction in damaged and missing goods.
	Timely completion of stock counts and reconciliation.
	Compliance with stock control procedures.
	Timely submission of stock reports.
	Zero unauthorized release or movement of company goods.


Required Qualifications and Skills


	Minimum of OND / HND / Bachelor’s Degree in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
	Previous experience in stock control, warehouse operations, inventory, or building materials/sanitary ware is an advantage.
	Good numerical and record-keeping skills.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to identify stock discrepancies.
	Basic computer and inventory software skills.
	Good communication and organizational skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.


Personal Attributes:


	The Stock Officer must be honest, accountable, organized, observant, physically fit, detail-oriented, and disciplined. The officer must demonstrate a high level of integrity because the position involves direct responsibility for company stock and stock records.


Authority and Accountability:


	The Stock Officer is accountable for the accuracy, safety, and proper documentation of stock under their custody. No goods should be released, transferred, or removed without proper authorization and documentation.
	Any negligence, unauthorized release of goods, falsification of stock records, concealment of discrepancies, or failure to report stock losses may result in disciplinary action in accordance with company policy.


Salary
N135,000 - N175,000 monthly.
